purpose: The install-tree identity rendered into README.md for the 0.0.47 candidate. The artefacts were rebuilt from the frozen source by the canonical recipe; this receipt binds the rendered identity to the bytes that build actually produced.

source_identity.measured_source_commit_subject: graduation: SAFE_COMPATIBLE issued for ssh and sshd at candidate b85c
source_identity.build_source_tree_digest_rule: sha256 over canonical JSON of sorted [relpath, size, sha256] for src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs (forensics/tools/phase7_courts.py::_source_tree_digest)
source_identity.release_tree_digest_rule: same rule and same enumeration, computed over the 0.0.47 packaging tree (the working tree's src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs).
source_identity.release_tree_digest_note: Unlike 0.0.46, the version bump is NOT committed when this build runs: the CMS free-contract wording, the free_lock lifetime probe and the 0.0.47 bump are all uncommitted. `measured_source_commit` therefore names HEAD only, and the tree digest is the identity of what was actually built. Recompute this digest after the orchestrator commits; the committed release commit must carry the same src/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock and build.rs bytes for these artefact hashes to remain bound.
source_identity.working_tree_at_build: dirty by design: src/cms/cms_lib.rs (SAFETY contract wording), src/runtime/thread.rs (#[cfg(test)] free_lock lifetime probe), Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock at 0.0.47, plus the tracked artefacts this rebuild rewrote.

build.why_rebuilt: the receipt must carry artefact hashes produced by an actual build of the frozen source; the previously committed artefacts were bound to 0.0.46 and to a source tree that this batch changed.

evidence_carried_forward.closure: the applied closure is not re-measured at this candidate; this receipt binds build identity only.
evidence_carried_forward.why: re-running the safety closure is a deliberate verification activity, not part of packaging.
evidence_carried_forward.mechanism_discharges: none claimed here; the ledger at measured_source_commit is the authority.

non_claims: No obligation is discharged by this receipt, and none is discharged by rebuilding.
The closure and downstream evidence are not re-measured at 0.0.47.
Passing the Phase 2 courts is an ABI/install-layout result, not a safety or cryptographic result.
The export counts are unchanged from 0.0.46 (libcrypto 5906, libssl 608); the artefact bytes differ because the source and build inputs differ, which is not a regression and not a safety result.
The recorded source identity is HEAD plus a tree digest; the batch and the version bump were uncommitted at build time.
